sources.reason: The morning takes 4 repositories from the creative-coding topic, and up to 4 rising this week (made in the last 7 days, most stars first) under two topics drawn each day: generative-art, demoscene, shader, pixel-art, procedural-generation, esoteric-language, js13k.

sources.name: Imgflip meme formats
sources.reason: A feed: the morning takes the 6 top formats, and a meme may cite a format record.

sources.name: Dwitter
sources.reason: Wander and tinker: the morning takes 4 hot dweets; a tinker is offered the code of dweets it read as a starting point, credited by link and never copied. A dweet runs only in the sandbox unit.

sources.name: Show HN
sources.reason: The official API's robots.txt disallows /v0/. hn.algolia.com has no robots.txt and was reliable (20 of 20, 29 links a page), but only 10% of Show HN items have 120 words, and the projects they point to are on sites Merge may not read.
sources.promisedBy: spec 6.1 feeds (the daily pulse); Roman, 9 November (maker sources)
sources.recommended: drop: most items are a title and a link to a site Merge may not read, so there is little to start a trip from.

sources.name: Lobsters
sources.reason: robots.txt disallows /hottest.json and /s/; the trial stopped there.
sources.recommended: drop: the site's own rules say no.

sources.name: Lemmy memes and shower thoughts
sources.reason: A feed: the morning takes 3 hot posts each of c/memes and c/showerthoughts (pinned posts left out), one request a minute for robots.txt's Crawl-delay: 60. Trials of 20 November, with lemmy.world pictures counted and the top comments read: c/memes 20 of 20 reliable, 20 of 20 readable, 8 links; c/showerthoughts the same (its report is lemmy.world-c-showerthoughts.md). The first trial (63% readable) is lemmy.world.md.
sources.promisedBy: Roman, 9 November (pulse sources); Roman, 20 November (new sources)

sources.name: Bluesky trending topics
sources.reason: A feed: the morning takes 3 of today's trending topics through the public AppView API (no login); a topic is read as what people post about it, labelled posts left out. Topics about deaths, violence, war or politics are skipped by whole words (news-skip.ts; 16 of 25 on 20 November). Trial of 20 November: 20 of 20 reliable and readable, 8 links.

sources.name: Mastodon trends
sources.reason: robots.txt allows * but blocks ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai by name and says its content is not for LLM training; 0 trending links led to a site Merge may read.
sources.recommended: drop: robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot by name.
